items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...we were playing the northern style... And Paul Whitman.

ctx.x: And of course you had to read because we have these little orchestrations, we have to play popular music. We weren't playing the New Orleans style of jazz, you know. We were playing the northern style, like, you know, and Charlie and Mark, Ishon Jones and --
-- Paul Whitman, and he called Isham Jones Ison Jones. But he liked their music.
